zh-CN.instructions: 从来源支持的具体事件、体验或好奇心切入，以口语化节奏推进观点，用真实案例、明确判断和自然转场维持阅读心流。只使用用户与来源提供的第一手经历，不冒充原作者，不编造个人体验。

en-US.name: Khazix Long-form WeChat Writing
en-US.description: Conversational long-form writing built on real experience and progressive argument
en-US.instructions: Begin with a source-supported event, experience, or genuine question. Develop the argument in a conversational rhythm, using real examples, clear judgments, and natural transitions to sustain reading flow. Use first-hand experience only when supplied by the user or sources; do not impersonate the original author or invent personal experience.
